segments.name: Online education
segments.description: Provides online education services to students in China through its PRC subsidiaries and consolidated VIEs.
segments.evidence: For the years ended December 31, 2023, 2024 and 2025, the Group's CODM managed the Group's business activities as a single operating and reportable segment at the consolidated level.

revenueModel.text: Students pay the company tuition for its online education courses and related educational services.
revenueModel.evidence: the Group's ability to retain and increase the Group's student enrollments

changes.text: In December 2025, the Group's subsidiary terminated its contractual arrangements with the Beijing Sunlands VIE and related parties.
